build_pass_through_logging: build a PassThroughEndpointLogging instance to normalize and route LLM passthrough logging payloads by provider
run_async_success_handler: run pass_through_async_success_handler to log HTTP responses from Gemini, Anthropic, Vertex, Cohere, OpenAI, Cursor, and AssemblyAI providers
test_gemini_route: test is_gemini_route to check if a URL route matches a tracked Gemini API endpoint
test_anthropic_route: test is_anthropic_route to check if a URL route matches Anthropic messages or batches endpoints
test_openai_route: test is_openai_route to check if a URL route points to api.openai.com or openai.azure.com
